data.gender_notes: Tymothy is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek name 'Timotheos', which is derived from 'timē' (honor) and 'theos' (God). This name was borne by several notable figures in the New Testament and early Christian history. The name Tymothy carries the meaning “God's honor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tymothy usually hope their child will grow to embody god's honor and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Timothy holds significant cultural importance in both ancient Greek and Christian traditions. In ancient Greek society, the name Timothy was given to children who were highly valued and respected, reflecting the meaning 'honor from God'. This name also became prominent in Christian history as the given name of two influential figures in the New Testament and early Christian church. The first, Timothy the Apostle, was a key companion and protege of the Apostle Paul, playing a significant role in spreading the Christian message. The second, Timothy the Evangelist, is recognized as the bishop of the cities of Seragonera, Catania and Messina in Sicily.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Timothy lies in its Greek roots - 'timē' (honor) and 'theos' (God). This name is a powerful reminder that an individual holds a special place in the eyes of both God and those around them. Timothy evokes a sense of reverence and respect for the divine, and those who bear this name are encouraged to live a life that is worthy of such honor. Timothy's connection to the Christian tradition further reinforces this spiritual significance, as he represents a commitment to spreading the message of love, grace, and forgiveness. In the face of adversity, the name Timothy serves as a reminder to stay true to one's faith and to cherish the honor God has bestowed upon us.
